title: Fix all bugs: unify Firebase auth, fix Firestore layer, add dashboard
head: fix/all-bugs
body:
Complete rewrite of the broken pieces + all bug fixes identified in the audit.

Critical fixes:
- Created src/lib/firebase.ts (the entire Firestore CRUD layer was missing)
- Fixed UserType (was a type alias, now a real enum)
- Fixed auth() (was an object, now verifies Firebase ID tokens)
- Fixed AuthProvider (was next-auth SessionProvider, now Firebase)
- Renamed proxy.ts to middleware.ts

Silent matching bugs fixed:
- listJobs() was ignoring its filter
- listCandidateUsers() queried lowercase 'candidate' but data stored as 'Candidate'
- listSwipesBySwiper() dropped the doc id
- Swipe route read employerProfile.userId (never written)

Made functional (were mocked):
- Forgot password - real sendPasswordResetEmail
- Email verification - real applyActionCode

New pages:
- /dashboard with role-based views + Google user onboarding
- /employer/swipe

Cleanup:
- Removed .env from public repo (rotate credentials now)
- Removed all NextAuth
- Deleted orphan files
- Merged duplicate next.config
- Rewrote firestore.rules

See MIGRATION_NOTES.md for full details.
